2f9247c06d.q: Why do association members join and stay according to Forge's State of Association Member Experience Report?
2f9247c06d.a: Overwhelmingly across the last five years, the top two reasons why members join and stay are for peer-to-peer connections and for ongoing learning and the opportunity to participate in education. 85% of respondents cite one of those two as the primary reason.
2f9247c06d.e: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay
2f9247c06d.rq: Trust in AI generated content went down from 31 percent to 26 percent year over year. But when that content is validated by an expert, the trust goes up to 49 percent.
ks: 85% of association members cite peer-to-peer connections or ongoing learning as primary reason to join and stay (Forge State of Association Member Experience Report, last five years)
1% of association members believe AI could replace what associations provide (Forge 2024 survey)
99% of association members say what associations provide is irreplaceable (Forge 2024 survey)
Trust in AI-generated content: 26% (down from 31% year over year); 49% when expert-validated (Forge research)
